title: Turnip, leek and cheddar tart with baked eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain kitchen food: butter, leeks, turnips, all-butter puff pastry, crème fraîche, cheddar and eggs.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including the ready-rolled puff pastry sheet, is an everyday item at Tesco or similar.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a baking tray and a fork, and scoring and pricking pastry is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Softened thin turnip slices on a scored puff base at 200°C, baked 20 minutes, then 8 minutes with an egg each, gives a sensible lunch for four.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and slicing the turnips and leeks plus 10 minutes of softening fits 20 minutes of prep, and the 28 minutes of baking matches the 30 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: All listed ingredients and seasonings, including the fresh thyme, appear in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm baked turnip and leek tart suits early February, and the 400g of turnips is the bulk of the filling.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper lunch with vegetables, eggs and cheese on a pastry base that a family would happily eat again.
